boundary.reason: RapidJSON's Reader, GenericDocument, and Writer APIs are C++ templates; one coarse extern C call per admitted operation translates the completed observation into a fixed-width record.
boundary.abi_test: test.sh checks C and Ada layout, symbols, nullability, prepared-DOM ownership, arbitrary Ada bounds, strictness, exact writer output, and failure publication.

portable.reason: C++17 with -O3 and NDEBUG, without a host-specific ISA compile flag.

native.reason: The portable release flags add -mcpu=native on arm64/aarch64 or -march=native on x86_64/amd64; other native architectures fail closed.

limitations: The admitted call constructs and recursively traverses a DOM.

lanes.api: flyology_json_bench_rapidjson_events uses Reader::Parse with kParseValidateEncodingFlag and kParseNumbersAsStringsFlag.
lanes.observable_result: Checksum over event kinds, decoded name/string lengths, exact number-span lengths, and container counts plus event, scalar, member-name, and exact input-byte counters.
limitations: The Reader consumes one complete contiguous input rather than an incremental chunk schedule.
Names and strings are decoded only for callback-scoped observation; no DOM is constructed.
One Reader is reused per calling thread; fixture preflight grows its decoded-string stack before measurement.
An initial UTF-8 BOM is rejected by the admitted Reader flags.
RapidJSON receives one complete contiguous input without adapter concatenation.

lanes.api: flyology_json_bench_rapidjson_dom uses GenericDocument::Parse with kParseValidateEncodingFlag and recursively visits every DOM value.
lanes.observable_result: Checksum over decoded strings, names, value kinds, and container counts plus event, scalar, member-name, and exact input-byte counters.
limitations: DOM allocation, string copying, number conversion, recursive traversal, and per-call cleanup are timed.
The adapter does not expose number lexemes or error offsets.
An initial UTF-8 BOM is accepted and ignored, so BOM fixtures are profile-disagreement evidence rather than primary throughput inputs.
No streaming writer boundary is included.

lanes.api: Prepare_Write constructs one reusable RapidJSON DOM outside timing; Write invokes GenericDocument::Accept with Writer<StringBuffer>.
lanes.observable_result: Exact output byte count plus an FNV-1a checksum over every output byte before the StringBuffer is destroyed.
limitations: This is a preconstructed-DOM serializer, not a streaming writer; it must not be ranked as write_stream.
DOM preparation, including input parsing, string copying, and number conversion, occurs outside timing.
RapidJSON allocates, grows, and destroys one StringBuffer during each timed operation.
Parsed numeric values may not preserve the input lexeme; only fixtures whose expected output matches this policy are admitted.
No combined parse-and-write boundary is included.

other_limits: Input size is bounded by size_t and available native-stack resources.
The callback observes each exact number span only for the duration of the call and does not retain it.
Input and DOM size are bounded by size_t, address space, and available allocation.
No explicit depth ceiling is configured; RapidJSON and the adapter consume allocator and native-stack resources.
This identity describes the reusable DOM supplied to write_dom, not timed parsing.
The maintained preflight prepares it with GenericDocument::Parse and kParseValidateEncodingFlag outside timing.
DOM and output size are bounded by RapidJSON SizeType, size_t, address space, and available allocation.

output_policies.number_spelling: render converted RapidJSON numeric values; exact source lexemes are not guaranteed
output_policies.control_escaping: short escapes where available; otherwise uppercase hexadecimal Unicode escapes
